top_3_arguments: Short entry at $19.40 is mechanically late and mean-reversion-risk-on: daily bollinger.pct_b = 0.0065 (price pinned to lower band $19.42), hourly rsi_21 = 23.66 (deeply oversold), and momentum.roc_5d = -22.79% on daily — the capitulation candle already happened on 2026-05-07 (47.4M volume = 3.44x avg, range $22.89→$18.53). Shorting at the lower BB after a -39% one-day drop is textbook chasing; the next move is statistically a bounce or sideways consolidation, not a fresh breakdown.

Overhead support shelf is dense and volume-confirmed: pivot_high $20.27 (8 tests, volume_confirmed=true) sits just $0.87 (4.5%) above current $19.50, and pivot_low $20.68 (8 tests) is right behind it. Watch_level $19.40 is barely 0.5% below current — invalidation $20.00 is only 2.6% away, well inside the daily ATR of $3.29 (16.85%). Any normal-volatility intraday wick takes out the stop; from a microstructure standpoint, the trade has roughly 1 ATR of room before invalidation, which is not a tradable edge.

Fundamental wall against the short thesis: Q1 was a beat-and-raise (revenue $173M +20% YoY, EPS 50% above consensus, FY26 guide raised to $710M-$725M, security +47% YoY for 4th straight accelerating quarter — sources dailypolitical.com 2026-05-06, finance.yahoo.com 2026-05-06). The -39% drop was expectations-reset on a 270%-prior-3-month rally, not a broken thesis. Stocktwits reports retail buying the dip aggressively. Price still sits +23.06% above EMA_200 ($15.85) and +44.39% above SMA_200 ($13.50) — the long-term uptrend is intact. Shorts piling on after the news is fully discounted is exactly the setup that produces a violent short-squeeze rip back to fib_786 = $22.02 or fib_618 = $24.75.
